audit_name: Inference Latency and Computational Acceleration Audit

speedup_evaluation.clarification: The ~447,000x speedup represents INFERENCE ACCELERATION comparing a full 72-hour numerical WRF-Chem cluster simulation (~4 hours = 14,400s) against DMDc 72-hour spectral forward rollout (0.032s). It is strictly an inference speedup metric, not an end-to-end data pipeline speedup.
